about: MM-INFER-VIS: the MoralMod negotiator's model steps as llm.call@1 with caller moralmod_negotiator. av-events (producer) -> agentvillage-data ingest (consumer). Observe-only, default OFF.

One event per chat.completions.create the Index plugin's loopback bridge makes (speaker.complete at indexnetwork/hermes-plugin 04d833b8), observed by wrapping the bridge's dedicated client only; Hermes's own pre_api_request / post_api_request never fire for these calls.

A valid llm.call@1 today (llm.call is open, additionalProperties true; caller is already typed by DATA-506's LLM_CALL_COST_PROPERTIES, ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$). Every other plugin llm.call sends no caller: null = Hermes's own request path (the agent's chat, cron, subagents). No backfill.

Closed: every key always present, in this order (the two above_metadata keys only above metadata capture); no message, tool, completion or prompt text, and no hash of any (tools_hash and system_prompt_hash are always null, prompt.registered is never sent).

key_source says whose OpenRouter key paid for the step: moralmod (AV_MORALMOD_OWN_KEY on and MORALMOD_LLM_API_KEY present: the bridge's dedicated client only) or tenant (today). Data can split the ledger on it.

Envelope: session_id, turn_id and run_id are always null (the bridge has no Hermes session); model_id = payload.model; actor agent; evidence_class agent_report; event_id a fresh uuid v7. A null session_id keeps the row out of core.sessions, core.runs and core.trajectories; it joins by tenant and day only.

consent_scope says how data should keep it: all = ops spend visibility for every tenant (to be kept without research consent only when caller is moralmod_negotiator and consent_scope is all, as code.run@1 is proposed); research_consented = research consent only, like every other llm.call. Until data adds that rule, the worker keeps it for research-consented tenants and drops it for the rest, as it does every plugin llm.call; nothing quarantines.
Held to plugins/av-events/_negotiator_llm.py by tests/test_negotiator_llm.py; agentvillage-data mirrors it in src/schemas/llm-call.ts and src/worker/consent.ts when it takes the ops rule.
patterns: every regex below is applied with fullmatch (Python re.fullmatch, TypeScript ^...$ without the m flag): a trailing newline never passes

switch.read: at plugin load (installs the wrap) and on every step (emits)

scope_switch.unknown_log: one WARNING per process naming the variable, never the value

model.source: the create call's model (the resident's gateway model)

input_tokens.source: Hermes normalize_usage(response.usage), as post_api_request; 0 on error

cost_usd.source: response.usage.cost when the provider carries it (OpenRouter), else null; the request is never changed to ask for it

generation_id.source: response.id when it is OpenRouter's generation id

status_code.null_when: the call returned, or the exception carries no HTTP status

key_source.source: moralmod when the bridge's client was built with MORALMOD_LLM_API_KEY (AV_MORALMOD_OWN_KEY on), else tenant (the switch off: the tenant's own OpenRouter key, today's behaviour)

own_key_switch.read: on every step (the bridge's _main_agent call); the seam is installed only when this switch or AV_EVENTS_NEGOTIATOR_LLM is on at plugin load (armed later: a gateway restart)
own_key_switch.missing_key: the step fails (MoralmodKeyUnavailable from _main_agent, the bridge's 502), counted moralmod_key_missing; never the tenant's key (CLAIMS L13060)
own_key_switch.invalid_or_out_of_credit: the step fails as a failed step fails today (the SDK error, the bridge's 502); never retried on the tenant's key; key_source moralmod with the HTTP status
own_key_switch.not_applicable: not OpenRouter over https, a custom Authorization or X-Api-Key header, no Hermes factory, the factory raising or returning another key: the step fails, counted moralmod_key_failed (and moralmod_key_unsupported for the shapes refused); never the tenant's key
own_key_switch.sanitiser: a present key is registered as a literal secret at plugin load, whatever the switches
own_key_switch.unload: with the switch on the bridge agent keeps its MoralMod client; with it off the tenant client goes back
